description:
Is there a physical sanctuary in Heaven? Does Jesus operate there? Pastor James Rafferty will illuminate this question and more with Daniel Perrin and Shelley Quinn.


Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 
By text: (618) 228-3975

QUESTIONS COVERED:


1. If you're no longer working, only drawing social security and your spouse's pension, do you still pay tithe out of that? Do you pay tithe off social security and pension?

2. What do the many Bible references of the right position and right hand mean? For example, Christ was sitting at the right side of God, He had 7 stars in his right hand, God says He will uphold us with His right hand, etc. Is there a significance in the right position or right hand? 

3. Is there a difference between Father Abraham being the father of all Nations and the children of Israel? Are they one and the same? Are"all nations" and the "children of Israel" one and the same?

4. Is there a physical sanctuary in Heaven that Jesus Christ operates in? 

5.  Is it a sin for a woman to touch or read the Bible during her monthly period? When I was younger my mom would not allow me to come up to the holy area of the church to sing or read the bible. Is it a sin to touch the Bible while on your monthly cycle?

6.  How do you know when the Holy Spirit is speaking? 

7.  How can I answer a mother who has had an abortion and now has turned her life around? Will she see her baby again in heaven? Will aborted babies be in heaven? 

8. Should we be washing dishes at church on Sabbath after lunch? I don't do dishes on Sabbath at home, but wait until the Sabbath is over. Please advise. 

9. Does the Bible tell us when the thief on the cross died? We know his legs were broken, but I don't think it says he actually died the same day that Jesus died. 

10.  On the cross Jesus prayed, "Father, forgive them, for they know not what they do." Was that for the priests, rulers, Pilate, or the crowd? We are told that those who crucified Him will see Him come in glory. Was the soldier forgiven who commented, "Surely, He was the son of God!" What about the thief who unselfishly, though ignorantly asked Jesus, "Save yourself and us." Was the requested forgiveness for the taunting crowd or the disillusioned, cowering disciples? Who did Jesus request forgiveness for on the cross?

11.  I understand being saved by the blood of Jesus is most important but I don't hear or see about healing the sick or casting out demons. Jesus did it and so did the disciples. Why don't we do this? Has this changed? Can we still heal the sick and cast out demons?

12.  1 Corinthians 15:53: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality. This confuses me. It says we are immortal. If we become immortal is our immortality conditional? Later it mentions the Tree of Life which we shall eat of. Are we only immortal if we eat of the tree of life (Revelation 2:7)? That would make us not really immortal, because we would have to eat of the tree to maintain life. I don't know what to think. Can you please explain 1 Corinthians 15:53?
